data.name: Stylized Spell Mastery
data.description: You have altered your understanding of a select number of spells. You do not modify the spell slot used when applying the Stylized Spell metamagic feat to any spell you have mastered with Spell Mastery. [Normal] A stylized spell uses up a spell slot 1 higher than the spell's actual level.
prerequisites: PRETEXT:Spell Mastery, Stylized Spell, Bluff 5 ranks, Spellcraft 5 ranks.
